import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    keep = n // 2 + 1
    heap = []
    for x in a:
        heapq.heappush(heap, -x)
        if len(heap) > keep:
            heapq.heappop(heap)
    print(-heap[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
